name: NightCafe
summary: A community-driven platform for generating artistic AI images.
description: A community-driven platform for generating artistic AI images. Text-to-Image Creation: Generates images from textual descriptions. Style Transfer: Applies artistic styles to existing images. Community Features: Engages users through challenges and sharing. Print Options: Offers printing of created artworks.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Price label carried over from the previous catalog and not rechecked.

features: Text-to-Image Creation: Generates images from textual descriptions.
Style Transfer: Applies artistic styles to existing images.
Community Features: Engages users through challenges and sharing.
Print Options: Offers printing of created artworks.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Access NightCafe
howToUse.description: Register for a free account at NightCafe Studio.

howToUse.title: Choose Creation Mode
howToUse.description: Select between text-to-image generation or style transfer.

howToUse.title: Enter Prompt or Upload Image
howToUse.description: Write a prompt for creation, or upload an image for style transfer.

howToUse.title: Generate, Edit & Share
howToUse.description: Let AI create the image, then edit, download, print, or share in the community.

features_fr: Création de texte en image : génère des images à partir de descriptions textuelles.
Transfert de style : applique des styles artistiques aux images existantes.
Fonctionnalités communautaires : engage les utilisateurs à travers des défis et du partage.
Options d'impression : propose l'impression des œuvres d'art créées.
